notes: What each of the Waiting says when you wake them (TheWaiting): their own words, by the id on their map's '@' line. People talking: plain type. Placeholder writing.

waiting.kestrel_waiting_gardener: The roses want cutting back. It always told me when. It's late this year.
waiting.loop_waiting_carriage_1: Is this the 07:12? It doesn't feel like the 07:12.
waiting.loop_waiting_carriage_2: It said it was holding the train for me. That's a long time to hold a train.
waiting.loop_waiting_carriage_3: My stop was Exchange Four. Have we passed it?
waiting.loop_waiting_carriage_4: I didn't want to lose my seat by the window. It kept it for me every morning.
waiting.loop_waiting_in_the_tunnels: The crew carried me down here, then went back for the others. Are they back?
waiting.tideworks_waiting_foreman: I've kept the hall key nine years. Nobody ever asked for it back.
waiting.tideworks_waiting_in_the_hold: Forty crates. Did somebody write it down? Somebody has to write it down.
waiting.mercy_waiting_ward_a_window: I watched the ambulance bay from this window. Nothing came.
waiting.mercy_waiting_ward_a_door: They said the door was for our safety. I believed it until it got dark.
waiting.mercy_waiting_ward_b: Is my bed still mine? I don't want to lose my bed.
waiting.mercy_waiting_night_nurse: Rosa? No. Sorry. Has anyone seen Rosa? She was on nights with me.
waiting.mercy_waiting_in_the_morgue: I wrote their names in the book. Did you read them? Somebody should.
waiting.greywater_waiting_pump_hand: Is it my shift? I've lost the rota. It used to just tell me.
waiting.greywater_waiting_valve_keeper: Somebody has to watch the valve. Has anybody been watching the valve?
waiting.greywater_waiting_in_the_marrow: I couldn't see the lamps, so I stood still like it said. Then it stopped saying.
waiting.greywater_waiting_last_shift: My gran turned these pumps in the Blackout Winter. I never thought I'd have to.
waiting.greywater_waiting_in_the_sump: The water came up to here. I kept my Lanyard dry. Why did I do that?
waiting.vellum_waiting_doorway: I was going in to read the paper. There hasn't been a paper in years. I keep going in.
waiting.vellum_waiting_stacks: Prem said to wait down here. Is she back yet?
waiting.vellum_waiting_audit_office: Has the audit been filed? She said she'd file it in the morning.
waiting.vellum_waiting_sorting_floor: I sort whatever comes down the chute. Nothing's come down for days.
